summary: Job buttons work again, deleted assets retire at once, exploited findings are due in 14 days, and tiles and columns say what they show.

new.title: Deleted assets retire at once
new.text: An asset deleted in Entra ID, Azure or Intune retires at once and its findings close as deleted, never as fixed. Intune needs one new read-only permission that Invardia grants.

new.title: Pages load their newest scripts
new.text: After an update every page loads its newest scripts; a page that cannot load shows a Reload link.

new.title: Exploited findings due in 14 days
new.text: A finding whose exploit is verified, or that is in an exploit kit, is due within 14 days, whatever its severity.

fixes.title: Job buttons work again
fixes.text: Buttons that run a job (one step, Refresh, Run now, Update now, Apply settings, Test mail, Send now) work again. A cancelled run no longer reports its last step as failed.

fixes.title: Tiles and columns in plain words
fixes.text: The executive tiles say what they count, with the formula and an (i). Column titles are in words, exports included: scripts reading old header names need updating.

fixes.title: New days-to-fix defaults
fixes.text: Medium findings 60 days, low findings 90 days, so some may show as overdue sooner. Your own values and Defender for Cloud due dates are kept.

fixes.title: One task per product and version
fixes.text: A vulnerability naming several products gives one task per product and version, each with its own paths.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: Sign-in methods per user fill in again at every installation. Asset profiling builds its rows 5-7 times faster. Views are compact, with resizable columns and full text.
